Talent0_2Ability.name: Trauma Profiling
Talent0_2Ability.SpecificEffects: When actively attacking with a Light Rifle and hitting an enemy, applies different <buf ID=900137>[Scar]</buf> effects based on the part type, lasting for <color=#F74848>2</color> turns. When an active attack applies <buf ID=900137>[Scar]</buf>, can additionally activate <buf ID=900004>[Re-ATK]</buf>, and can move <color=#F74848>2</color> tiles before attacking. Can only trigger <color=#F74848>1</color> time per turn.

300001.name: Sniper Warfare 1
300001.SpecificEffects: After destroying the target, triggers <buf ID=900004>[Re-ATK]</buf>. Can trigger up to <color=#F74848>2</color> times per turn. Unable to move before attacking.

700048.name: Sabotage
700048.SpecificEffects: When actively attacking, deals an additional <color=#F74848>20%</color> DMG to parts with HP below <color=#F74848>50%</color>.

301203.name: Forensics
301203.describe: Designates <color=#F74848>1</color> enemy unit within a <range type=0>4-tile diamond</range> range, applying <color=#F74848>1</color> corresponding <buf ID=900137>[Scar]</buf> effect to its lowest-HP part. Can continue to act afterward, but cannot move before attacking.

301204.name: Scar Retrieval
301204.SpecificEffects: When performing an active attack, if the target part affected with the corresponding <buf ID=900137>[Scar]</buf> effect is destroyed, all AP consumed by the skill used is returned after combat, up to <color=#F74848>3</color>. Can only trigger <color=#F74848>1</color> time per turn.

301205.name: Remote Deconstruction
301205.SpecificEffects: When actively attacking, Hit Rate <color=#F74848>+4%</color> for every <color=#F74848>1</color> tile away from the target, up to <color=#F74848>20%</color>.

301206.name: Total Deconstruction
301206.describe: Uses a Light Rifle to attack a target, dealing <color=#F74848>1.5x</color> DMG. Enters <buf ID=900014>[Aiming]</buf> Mode before attacking. After combat, applies all <buf ID=900137>[Scar]</buf> effects to the target hit, lasting for <color=#F74848>2</color> turns.

301207.name: Battlefield Awareness
301207.SpecificEffects: For each <buf ID=900137>[Scar]</buf> effect on the battlefield, Crit DMG <color=#F74848>+4%</color>, up to <color=#F74848>20%</color>.

301208.name: Multi-Vector Mapping
301208.describe: Uses a Light Rifle to attack a target, dealing <color=#F74848>0.7x</color> DMG. Can choose <color=#F74848>2</color> additional targets, each dealing <color=#F74848>0.7x</color> DMG. Enters <buf ID=900014>[Aiming]</buf> Mode before attacking and can repeatedly lock onto the same target. Can be retaliated against by the main target.

300011.name: Sniper Warfare 2
300011.SpecificEffects: [Sniper Warfare 1] can trigger after destroying a part.

300021.name: Sniper Warfare 3
300021.SpecificEffects: Upon triggering [Sniper Warfare 1]'s <buf ID=900004>[Re-ATK]</buf>, can move <color=#F74848>2</color> tiles before attacking.

300022.name: Power Innovation 2
300022.SpecificEffects: When destroying a part, restores <color=#F74848>1</color> AP after combat. Can only trigger <color=#F74848>1</color> time per turn.

301231.name: Hunter's Mark 1
301231.SpecificEffects: When actively attacking with a Ranged Weapon and destroying a part, gains different <buf ID=900141>[Hunter's Boon]</buf> effects based on the part type. Can only trigger <color=#F74848>2</color> times per turn.

301234.name: Hunter's Mark 2
301234.SpecificEffects: When actively attacking with a Ranged Weapon, if the target is destroyed, can move an extra <color=#F74848>3</color> tiles.

301235.name: Hunter's Mark 3
301235.SpecificEffects: [Hunter's Mark 1] can now trigger an unlimited number of times per turn.

301236.name: Hunter's Mark 4
301236.SpecificEffects: At start of action, randomly gains <color=#F74848>1</color> unacquired <buf ID=900141>[Hunter's Boon]</buf> effect.

301241.name: Veilpiercer 1
301241.SpecificEffects: After actively attacking, if the target has <buf ID=900137>[Scar]</buf>, <buf ID=900004>[Re-ATK]</buf> triggers after combat. Can move <color=#F74848>2</color> tiles before attacking. Can trigger <color=#F74848>1</color> time per turn.

300043.name: Power Innovation 3
300043.SpecificEffects: When destroying a target, additionally restores <color=#F74848>1</color> AP after combat. Can trigger up to <color=#F74848>2</color> times per turn.

301244.name: Veilpiercer 2
301244.SpecificEffects: Each time Core Talent is triggered, simultaneously applies <buf ID=900137>[Scar]</buf> to units of the same faction within <color=#F74848>1</color> ring around the target.

301245.name: Veilpiercer 3
301245.SpecificEffects: When attacking a target affected by <buf ID=900137>[Scar]</buf>, Final DMG <color=#F74848>+5%</color>. For each additional <color=#F74848>1</color> <buf ID=900137>[Scar]</buf>, DMG increases by an extra <color=#F74848>5%</color>, up to <color=#F74848>15%</color>.

301246.name: Veilpiercer 4
301246.SpecificEffects: After triggering talent's <buf ID=900004>[Re-ATK]</buf> effect, changes to <buf ID=900005>[Re-Act]</buf>.

hiddenSkills.name: Targeted Diagnosis
hiddenSkills.describe: Uses a Light Rifle to attack a target, dealing <color=#F74848>1.25x</color> DMG. If there are no allied units within <color=#F74848>2</color> tiles, enters <buf ID=900014>[Aiming]</buf> Mode before attacking.

Introduction: An elite pilot of the Reversion Squad, and a composed, highly professional agent of the Oversight Committee.
